ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are very sorry to hear about this issue.It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator.To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

Results.ReviewText: It's been great to cook burgers, steaks, roasts, veggies, hot dogs and all sorts of food. The hot spots are easy to work with, I just make sure to rotate food around while i'm cooking, and when the grill isn't as full, i have preferred spots to cook.  The rotisserie interference with the movable side table is a let down.  I feel that this could have been part of the engineering requirements of the grill and all accessories from the design phase, and would be easy to resolve with some vertical adjustment of parts.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: First of all, what great packing. I've been in manufacturing for 40 years and I have never seen a product better packaged/protected in my career. Assembly was fairly easy, grill is sturdy and works great. No complaints with any of this. The only thing that keeps me from giving it 5 stars is what happened to the side trays after less than a month of use. When uncovering the grill to start cooking one day, i noticed what looked like bits of barbeque sauce on the side trays. I tried cleaning them but the spots would not go away and started looking more like rust than splatter. We contacted Weber to ask about this. They confirmed our warrantee information and decided to send us replacement trays without hesitation. Great customer service. Still don't know why this happened to the stainless steel trays that were not left exposed to the elements. Overall I am very happy with this grill. Works well in all respects.
Results.Title: Solid grill, but rust?

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill has exceeded my expectations. While I am a smoker at heart, I recognized the need for a grill for burgers and steaks as I was getting tired of having a house filled with smoke. I wanted something that was big enough for a family of 4, but didn’t need all the bells and whistles of higher end grills either. After doing some shopping I settled in on this model. Setup is simple yet intimidating to look at. Please download the app with 3D instructions!! This was awesome!!!! This model is quite sturdy and the grill grates are heavy duty. All 3 burners appear to heat equally, which has not been my experience with gas grills. The size is perfect for the 4 of us. Only complaint would be that it doesn’t get hot enough for searing thinner steaks like a 3/4in porterhouse, but more than does the trick for thicker steaks, burgers, brats, and chicken.
Results.Title: Buy with confidence!!
